title: Clause at a seed and index
statement: Let $V$ be a Boolean-valued PCPP system making $r$ possible queries, let $K$ be a natural number, and let a seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ have exactly $K$ clauses for each seed. For a seed $s$ and an index $q\in\{0,\ldots,K-1\}$, the clause at $(s,q)$ is the $q$th clause of the CNF formula assigned to $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a Boolean-valued PCPP system with $r$ possible queries
A seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ with parameter $K$
